h: Content creator Genevieve urges Nigerians to stop voting along tribal lines
p: Creator Genevieve has reportedly said tribal loyalty should not outweigh capability and good governance when Nigerians vote in 2027. Her comments, aimed at some supporters of the president, have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Some users agreed, while others accused her of taking sides.
Ethnic and regional voting patterns are a major talking point ahead of 2027.
